name: multiverse-frontend
description: Website for the Multiverse Android app — landing page, privacy policy and terms.

scripts.//build: --webpack is required, not a preference. Next 16 builds with Turbopack by default, and Turbopack only works with native SWC bindings. Hostinger's build container ships glibc older than 2.29, so @next/swc-linux-x64-gnu cannot load there and Next falls back to WASM — which Turbopack refuses, failing the build. Webpack works with the WASM bindings. Slower, but one script that builds everywhere.
